This was just more of an experiment to see if it could be done. I made it on another site, and while it is working out, it’s not really something I’m into nor want associated with my image. 
Why did I make it, you ask? Well let me riff on old quote:
I was so preoccupied with whether or not I could, I didn’t stop to think if I should.

Take and play as is, edit if you wish, even mirror it on other sites for all I care. I release this unto the world open-source. I know there’s people out there who like this sort of thing, so have at it.
